regions.merged_text: God bless you Owen and Martha and all the family. Many thanks Owen for your kind favor of last week from Los Angeles. Glad to know all are well down there. Thank God Fr. M. Joachim and myself are well too. I am hoping co go down to see him before long. I am confident that this experience of his will prove to have been a manifest blessing for him and for us all. Pray that it may.
